environment.metadata_observation: post-run read-only CIM/file/build-metadata snapshot; not continuous run telemetry

adapter_correctness.scope: small actual-caller fixture; generated Search is fresh-static-snapshot only

cost_recipe.checksum: cumulative sum of (rank+1) for the other 13 hit queries; two misses add zero; the first hit query is asserted separately and not summed
cost_recipe.timing: steady_clock nanoseconds; mutation separate; first lookup separate; other15 group separate; query construction/oracle/JSON output excluded; counters included
cost_recipe.summary_statistic: median/min/max of three retained sample means, each mean covers 32 rounds; other15 is a group, not per-lookup
cost_recipe.probes: lookup loop comparisons/visits only; table build traversal/unique check/sort are excluded; ordered lookup also counts its final equality access
cost_recipe.rebuild_timing: lazy unsorted first lookup includes allocation, traversal, sort, validation, old-vector disposal and lookup
cost_recipe.memory_metric: current position-vector capacity payload only; excludes simultaneous old/new vectors, allocator overhead, sort workspace, other state and RSS

offline_audit.preservation_scope: all preflight-v1/v2/v3, compile-r164-0/1 and both executed lease/raw/supervisor directories plus actual executable/tlog; post check retained privately
offline_audit.final_publication_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF; final postcheck validates all numeric sample summaries and reconstructs every original CRLF stdout

recommendation: keep one identity/document-order seam and the proven-sorted fast path; prioritize lazy-table as an unordered candidate with scan as correctness reference; do not choose a permanent container or ship before production change-notification closure and actual caller/query-cadence validation

scope.privacy: only fixed synthetic numeric fields, hashes and path-free environment metadata; no raw plans, private paths, PID, account or machine identity
